## Pull Request Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes introduced in this PR.

## Associated Issue
Closes #(issue-number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking fix for an identified defect)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking addition to functionality)
- [ ] Automation / CI/CD improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Code quality improvement

## Verification & Testing Performed
- [ ] Local build passes: `mvn clean package`
- [ ] Selenium E2E tests pass: `mvn test`
- [ ] Manual verification in browser completed
- [ ] No regressions in complaint submission, tracking, or review

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project conventions and style guidelines
- [ ] Comments and docstrings are preserved or added where helpful
- [ ] No secrets, passwords, or personal credentials committed
- [ ] Changes do not break backwards compatibility
